turns.user_utterance: Hello, I found the card I misplaced and I need to reactive it, how do I do that?
turns.assistant_response: Glad you found it! If the card was previously deactivated after you misplaced it, you’ll usually need to reactivate it in the app—please open your Revolut app, go to Cards, select your card, and choose the option to activate/reactivate. Was your card ever marked as lost/stolen in the app (or reported to support), or did you just temporarily suspend it yourself?

turns.user_utterance: I just temporarily suspended it myself; I never marked it as lost or stolen.
turns.assistant_response: Perfect—since you only temporarily suspended it (not marked lost/stolen), you can reactivate it yourself. Please open the Revolut app → **Cards** → select your card → tap **Activate/Reactivate**. If you don’t see that option, tell me whether your card is **physical** or **virtual** and what the app shows on the card screen.
